description:
Vital Recorder 1.16.6 is open on the Windows desktop showing an empty workspace with the message 'Open File or Add Device' in the center. The toolbar at the top has several icons. A real surgical vital signs recording file '0001.vital' from the VitalDB open dataset (Seoul National University Hospital) is located at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\VitalRecorderData\0001.vital. This file contains approximately 3 hours of intraoperative monitoring data from a noncardiac surgery case, including arterial blood pressure (ART), ECG waveforms (ECG_II, ECG_V5), pulse oximetry (PLETH), capnography (CO2), airway pressure (AWP), and anesthetic agent concentrations (INSP_SEVO, EXP_SEVO).

Your task:
1. In Vital Recorder, open the file '0001.vital' from C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\VitalRecorderData\ using the Open Folder icon button in the toolbar (the second icon from the left) or an equivalent method.
2. After the file loads, verify that physiological data tracks (such as ART, ECG_II, PLETH, CO2) are visible as waveform traces in the track window.
3. The file should be fully loaded with the title bar showing '0001' and a duration of approximately 3 hours 12 minutes.
